rules: First entry at virginity>0 sets initialized=1,prev=current,checked=1 and grants no generic retrospective draw.
A fresh virginity0->>=2 transition with prev=0 and checked=0 consumes checked=1 once. Only permit1 draws rand(1,100)<=5.
Existing known=1 and virginity>=2 normalizes to4 and applies one-time rank minima when initialized<2.
Repeated actions after a failed draw do not re-roll. A 95 percent failure alone is expected for a correctly supported eligible first transition.
